title: Corner glass shelf 3-Tier 8-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Hardware for Bathroom Storage Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage to unused corner space with a wall mount corner glass shelf built with three tiers and thick tempered glass. This piece is part of the Foxtrot collection, making it easy to create a matching Foxtrot bathroom with coordinated designer bath accessories and designer bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Three-tier corner glass shelf (corner wall shelf) keeps toiletries and décor organized
- 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges for safety and strength
- Solid brass hardware supports a durable, contemporary look
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, built-in appearance
- Wide variety of lifetime designer finishes for textured bathroom hardware and statement bath accessories styling

Specs:
- Size: 8-Inch L x 8-Inch W x 15-Inch H
- Glass thickness: 0.39 in
- Mount type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
